name: Pipedream
tagline: Pipedream is a developer-focused workflow automation platform where every step can be written in Node.js, Python, Go, or Bash — making it far more powerful than Zapier for technical use cases. It connects to 1,000+ APIs with pre-built auth and can be triggered by HTTP requests, schedules, events, or queues. Engineering teams use Pipedream to build production-grade integrations and internal tools without standing up dedicated microservices.
